Hi Priya,

Thank you for your reply about the boiler at Flat 4, 18 Orchard Rise (ref R/1 / NBL-T1-551). We have noted that you want Brightwell Gas used and that you want a call before anything over £300 is spent.

We're treating this as an emergency. The tenant has a 3-month-old baby who now has a cough, and there has been no heating or hot water since last night. We have not booked anyone or committed any spend. A member of our team will call you today to agree the next step with Brightwell Gas, including the cost if their price is likely to be over £300.

If it's easier, please send us Brightwell Gas's contact details by reply.

Kind regards,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings
